title: Executors and callback groups
keywords: executor executors callback callbacks callback_group spin single_threaded multi_threaded deadlock timer blocked
text: An executor runs a node's callbacks: subscriptions, timers, services and actions. The single-threaded executor runs one callback at a time, so a slow callback delays all the others, and waiting for a service response inside a callback can deadlock. The multi-threaded executor runs callbacks in parallel within callback groups: a mutually exclusive group never runs two of its callbacks at once, a reentrant group can. Data that arrives late or a timer that stops firing is often a blocked executor, not a network problem.
